_comment: Provenance of the facts in data/sitedata.js, one entry per place id. Seeded 2026-10-18 from a research pass (OpenStreetMap via Nominatim/Overpass, official DTPC/Kerala Tourism pages); read by scripts/verify-data.mjs. Never copy coordinates, hours or phone numbers from Google Maps. A missing field means not verified. confidence: high/medium = official source; low = third party, not applied to the site.

1.name: Santhinatha Temple (no such place found in Wayanad)

coordinate.evidence: No Santhinatha/Shanthinatha place_of_worship in OSM within the Wayanad bbox (Nominatim + Overpass name search); web search finds only Karnataka temples (Shanthigrama, Dharwad). Stated point is a residential road at Mottakkunnu, Venniyodu (Nominatim reverse way/621407031).

anomalies: Place could not be identified; page text is generic filler
stated_km 17 has no checkable target
1.notes: Jain temples actually in Wayanad: Ananthanatha (Puliyarmala), Sultan Bathery Jain Temple, Koottamunda glass temple, Mananthavady Adhishwara. Owner to decide whether this record meant one of them.

2.name: Ananthanatha Swami Jain Temple, Puliyarmala

coordinate.evidence: Area-level only: stated point is in Ananthakrishnapuram/Puliyarmala (Kainatti) on the Kalpetta-Mananthavady road, 40 m from Krishna Gowder Hall (way/1105134786). Kerala Tourism: temple on Puliyar Mala, ~5 km from Kalpetta; OSRM 4.7 km agrees. The temple building is not mapped at that spot in OSM. OSM way/890156945 labelled 'Ananthanatha Swami Jain Temple' is at 11.7055,76.1041 (Palakkamoola, 7.4 km away, tagged religion=hindu): likely a different or mislabeled object. Also node/10945867708 'jain temple' at 11.6245,76.0922 (Kainatti bypass road) is unexplained.

anomalies: Site timing 09:00-17:00 closed Sun is unsupported; a Jain directory lists morning and evening sessions (seen via search snippet, page itself not fetchable)
2.notes: Confirm the temple gate coordinate on the ground and add it to OSM.

3.name: Koottamunda Glass Temple (Parswanatha Swami Jain Temple), Vellarimala

coordinate.evidence: Kerala Tourism: Jain temple of Parswanatha Swami on the slopes of Vellarimala, ~20 km from Kalpetta. No OSM feature by that name (Nominatim/Overpass). Stated point is on Calicut-Vythiri-Gudalur Road at Chundale (way/30778559), 3.8 km from Kalpetta, which contradicts the 20 km. OSM node Vellarimala (11.4514,76.1433) is a locality tagged Kozhikode, not a temple position.

anomalies: Stated coordinate is ~3.8 km from Kalpetta but stated road distance is 20 km (coordinate wrong, already withheld)
Temple not mapped in OSM

4.name: Thirunelli Maha Vishnu Temple

coordinate.evidence: OSM way 'Thirunelli Vishnu Kshetram' (place_of_worship, wikidata Q7785405) centre 11.91171,75.99585; stated point within ~10 m.

anomalies: stated_km 64 vs OSRM 48.3 (diff 15.7 km, 32%): stated figure is wrong; sister record #5 says 49
Site timing 05:30-12:30/17:00-19:30 and closed Sun not supported: DTPC says open every day; Kerala Tourism evening session to 20:30 per search snippet
4.notes: Only the km figure needs fixing (use about 48-49). DTPC hours may be office hours.

stated_km 49 vs OSRM 47.7 fine
5.notes: DTPC: Papanasini surrounds the temple. No separate timing.

anomalies: Name says Sultan Bathery but the place is Pulpally
Coordinate cannot be confirmed from OSM
6.notes: Do not use the stated coordinate for distances until verified on site.

7.name: Meenangadi church (which church is unclear)

coordinate.evidence: Stated point is in a cluster on Kalpetta-Sulthan Bathery Rd: St Peter's Orthodox Valiya Palli (node/6726433194, 55 m), St Peter & St Paul Jacobite Cathedral (node/9019418309, 70 m). St Mary's Soonoro Syriac Orthodox church (node/7057382234, 11.65933,76.16761) is 0.66 km W and is the Marian pilgrim centre listed by Wikipedia (no coordinates taken from Wikipedia).

anomalies: Record has no church name; Kerala Tourism/DTPC 'Pallikunnu church, Meenangadi' is the Lourdes church (see #8), so #7 could be a mislabel or duplicate of #8
7.notes: Owner should name the intended church (likely St Mary's Soonoro pilgrim centre or St Peter's).

Site km 21 vs OSRM 27.5 km from stated point
